body.condition: For every \(V\in\{D,Y\}\) and \(\ell\in\{-,+\}\), the one-sided regression \(\mu_{V,P}^{\ell}\) admits an extension to \([0,1]\) in the radius-\(M\) H\"older ball of order \(s\), with the derivative interpreted in the usual way when \(s>1\).

standard.name: Adapted/sufficient specialization, cf. NoackRothe2024 (one-sided observable H{\"o}lder extensions)
